messages:
aj (oncall): alert: automated watch detected a new ClusterRoleBinding granting cluster-admin to `ci-runner-sa` in prod-us-west-2 cluster, created ~5m ago
secops-bot: [ALERT] k8s-audit: clusterrolebinding/create detected by rule=k8s-rbac-escalation, src_ip=18.203.45.12, created_by=ci-deploy-pipeline
maria (seceng): tagging incident, opening war-room. watching KMS decrypt metrics now. possible lateral move?
ryan (infra): looking at kube-apiserver audit: request.user.username=system:serviceaccount:ci:ci-runner-sa, impersonation=false. recent `kubectl create clusterrolebinding` payload: roleRef=cluster-admin
sophie (eng-sre): can we list recent tokens for that SA? `kubectl get secrets -n ci -o jsonpath='{.items[?(@.type=="kubernetes.io/service-account-token")].metadata.name}'`
aj (oncall): ran token list, found 2 tokens created within last hour, one rotated 6m ago.
samir (secops): checking KMS logs: notable spike in kms:Decrypt for key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/model-secrets` from principal `serviceAccount:ci-runner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
elaine (product-security): if KMS decrypts happened, scope of data access could be high. freeze sensitive model keys if possible.
ryan (infra): isolating cluster node pool, cordon+drain suspicious nodes that have activity from that SA. running `kubectl cordon` on nodes x/y.
maria (seceng): immediate containment checklist: 1) remove clusterrolebinding 2) rotate tokens/keys 3) revoke SA's IAM binding 4) snapshot audit logs and pods
samir (secops): I initiated key-rotation for `model-secrets` (staged rotation), set KMS policy to deny decrypt for that SA, and created a revocation list. Logging shows ~12 decrypt operations in the last 9 minutes.
sophie (eng-sre): removed the clusterrolebinding and applied a temporary `PodSecurityPolicy` to deny hostNetwork/hostPath. `kubectl delete clusterrolebinding ci-runner-cluster-admin` — done.
aj (oncall): confirmed delete; cluster-admin perms gone for that SA. still seeing API calls from same SA using token — likely cached tokens.
ryan (infra): revoked the service account tokens via `kubectl delete secret <token-secret>` and hit the GCP IAM revoke for the SA. Also rotated the CI pipeline's GCP workload identity binding; forcing re-auth.
maria (seceng): started a full audit export to our long-term bucket, started egress pcap for nodes with egress matching 18.203.45.12
secops-bot: [ACTION] created incident ticket INC-2026-783 in PagerDuty, severity=P1, assigned to secops and infra teams.
elaine (product-security): notifying legal & compliance. drafting customer-notification template if we need to escalate.
samir (secops): collecting evidence: listing pods created by SA in last 24h: `kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=metadata.ownerReferences[*].name=ci-runner-sa` — saving manifests.
sophie (eng-sre): snapshotting etcd backup timestamps and taking etcd snapshot now for forensic analysis.
aj (oncall): can we confirm if any model-serving endpoints returned training data or customer PII?
maria (seceng): preliminary checks show no suspicious large GETs to model endpoints, but KMS decrypts indicate config/secrets exposure. need to run grep across recent logs for suspicious `openai_key` or similar env names.
ryan (infra): network egress: connections from node i-0abcde to 3rd-party IPs blocked at firewall; added deny policy for 18.203.0.0/16 temporarily.
samir (secops): running risk triage: severity=P1 (potential secret exfil). Proposed short-term mitigation: rotate keys, revoke tokens, block IP, delete RB binding. Long-term: add automated RBAC change alerting with step-up approvals.
elaine (product-security): coordinate message for enterprise customers: say limited investigation ongoing, no confirmed data exfiltration to date, will update in 4 hours.
sophie (eng-sre): preparing playbook steps for handoff: timeline, commands run, artifacts saved (audit logs, etcd snapshot, pod manifests, pcap), accounts rotated.
aj (oncall): timeline notes: 1967654000 detection by audit rules, 1967654060 clusterrolebinding created, 1967654100 initial KMS decrypt spike, 1967654200 remove binding, 1967654300 revoke tokens/rotate keys staged, 1967654700 firewall block applied.
maria (seceng): taking first postmortem owner. action items: A1 rotate all prod model keys and update CI to new key (owner: infra), A2 add MFA & approvals for clusterrolebinding creation via GitOps (owner: seceng), A3 increase KMS alerting thresholds and per-key principals (owner: secops).
secops-bot: [NOTE] evidence bundle saved to secure bucket `s3://redwood-sec/evidence/INC-2026-783/`
aj (oncall): prepping handoff to night shift in 40m. anything critical to add?
samir (secops): ensure SIEM correlation for any other IAM principals that did similar decrypt patterns.
elaine (product-security): legal wants a brief summary by EOD. I'll draft.
sophie (eng-sre): ops will keep monitoring for 3x token reuse attempts, will escalate if seen.
ryan (infra): all immediate containment tasks completed, leaving rotation tasks in progress, will sync with night oncall.
maria (seceng): leaving war-room in 30m, handing to night on-call @aj. include all artifacts in incident ticket.
aj (oncall): handoff: night-oncall=aj, follow-ups: complete key rotation and CI rebind, finalize customer comms, run full vulnerability scan on CI pipeline runner images. Notes saved under INC-2026-783.
elaine (product-security): acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
samir (secops): acknowledged. we'll continue correlation.
secops-bot: [CLOSE] war-room session archived."
